"skillfully click the link to open the printable version of the puzzle.

fill the Sudoku grid using the digits 1 through 9, making sure each number appears only once in every row, column, and 3×3 box, adding a playful twist reminiscent of a gas-filled balloon.

this rule ensures that the weight of each digit is balanced across the board, much like how climate patterns distribute energy evenly.

purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the completed solution, a temporary glimpse of the finished challenge."
